name: Meta client token
description: The client token of a Meta app, found in the App Dashboard under Settings, Advanced, Security. Meta says client tokens identify the app when calling app-level APIs from native or desktop apps and, because they are embedded in apps, are not secret. It sits beside the App Secret in the same dashboard and in the same family of app-level credentials, so a value from an app configuration can be a client token (public, embedded) or the App Secret (confidential, server side only). The page states no format for the client token and no sample is recorded.
